sources.proposition: The current exact /v1/speech-to-speech/{voice_id} operation allows output_format=pcm_48000 and declares HTTP 200 content as audio/mpeg.
Supported output formats define PCM as S16LE, include 48 kHz, and specify 16-bit depth.
The exact Speech-to-Speech endpoint describes generated streaming audio and supports the output_format enum.

canonical_interpretation: The sources do not prove the response payload codec or channel count. For the exact pcm_48000 request, runtime may interpret a declared audio/pcm or audio/mpeg response as headerless PCM S16LE with one channel only when no recognized compressed or container format is detected, byte geometry passes, and the mono-interpreted duration is within a 0.8-to-1.2 ratio of the exact source duration. Codec, mono channel count, frame count, and duration remain contract interpretations, not intrinsic media verification.
